what: Post-launch delta gate lacks a set-difference algorithm
scenario_or_breakage: Edge case promises pre-existing dirty is excluded, but gate 3 only says compare snapshots and bail if delta is empty; a naive `[[ -n "$(git status --porcelain …)" ]]` check would false-positive recover on pre-launch dirtiness; M2/M7 do not catch that
suggested_fix: Specify implementation: capture `git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` into `$TMPDIR_ARG/step2-prelaunch-porcelain.txt` on first write (Step 1), then `comm -13 <(sort pre) <(sort post)` (or equivalent) for non-empty delta; add harness case with pre-seeded dirty file + empty post-stub delta
